info.name: Cinema Management API
info.description: 321-4002 Cinema Management backend - full API coverage: auth lifecycle, program lifecycle (all 7 state transitions), screening lifecycle (all 8 state transitions incl. auto-rejection), role permissions incl. ADMIN exclusion, search + redaction by role, idempotency, rate limiting, and the {timestamp,status,errorCode,message} error contract. Built against the CURRENT, post-M6 API surface (NOT the historical existing/.../postman draft).
